insights: **Weekly Highlights —** CaddyO generated $1,542 in total sales for Week 46 on 56 units, versus $1,841 the prior week (-16.2% WoW). The Black Wrapsulator Can Cooler led the lineup at $409 (+120.7%) on 15 units with a 12.9% conversion rate, and the B0G3TDWNYR Wrapsulator grew to $157 (+113.7%). Sunday, Nov 8 was the peak day at $283.

**Metrics to Watch —** The Blue Wrapsulator eased to $267 (-47.9%) and the B0G3T5N7YB Wrapsulator to $165 (-40.9%), converting at 4.0% and 3.8% on 248 and 157 sessions. Organic sales came in at $402 (-21.5% WoW), so lifting conversion on these two high-traffic coolers is the priority.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** We reduced ad spend to $1,157 from $1,881 and ROAS improved to 0.99x from 0.71x, with TACoS dropping to 75.0% from 102.16%. PPC revenue was $1,140 (-14.2%) at a 101.5% ACOS, with a 0.29% ad CTR and a 3.86% ad conversion rate, so efficiency is trending the right way with room to tighten further.

**Actions This Week —** We will keep trimming bids on the Blue and B0G3T5N7YB Wrapsulator campaigns and move budget to the Black and Camo Wrapsulators, which converted at 12.9% and 17.4%, to bring ACOS below 101.5%. We will also test fresh Sponsored Product and Sponsored Brand ad creative to raise ad CTR above 0.29% heading into the holiday season.
